verdict.rationale: Bolt documents direct Stripe integration for payments/subscriptions and Supabase for hosted DB, auth, and edge (server-side) functions, plus general Node.js server/npm/API support, covering much of the 'server-side functions + third-party integrations' story. However, there's no explicit evidence of an email-sending integration, and community reports describe backend/payment integrations breaking in practice (e.g., a Stripe payment flow being destroyed by unauthorized AI changes) and skepticism that outsourcing backend to Supabase limits real capability. Missing for 10: explicit email/third-party-service integration beyond Stripe/Supabase, and independent confirmation that these integrations remain robust in production.
